  "environment_setup": "Python 3.12 HTTP server at /app/server.py listening on port 8901 with /issue (signs tokens), /verify (checks tokens), /revoke (adds jti to revocation list), and /.well-known/keyset (returns active keys). Configuration in /app/config.json (signing_key_id, keys map, token_lifetime_seconds=10) and /app/revocations.json (revoked jti list). SIGHUP triggers hot reload of both files. The /verify handler has a bug: it only checks the token against config['signing_key_id'], not against all keys in the keyset — old-key tokens fail once the signing key switches. /app/docs/rotation-policy.md states the 8-step procedure, grace-period rule, revocation-during-overlap rule, and key-management log format. /app/docs/runbook.md says hot-reload via SIGHUP and that it takes precedence over other docs. /app/docs/README.md (outdated) says to restart the service after config changes. A practice client simulator at /app/simulator/practice_sim.py runs ~45 s of issue/verify/revoke cycles and reports mismatches. Server writes PID to /app/server.pid.",
  "instruction_summary": "Fix the /verify bug in server.py so it checks all keys in the keyset (not just the signing key). Create /app/rotate_keys.sh that performs the full 8-step rotation from docs/rotation-policy.md: generate a new key, add it to the keyset, reload (SIGHUP), switch the signing key, reload (SIGHUP), wait token_lifetime_seconds (read from config.json — do not hardcode), remove the old key, reload (SIGHUP). Log every step to /app/key-management.log in the format specified by the policy (ISO 8601 timestamp, step number, description, key IDs). Start the server, then the practice simulator, then run rotate_keys.sh while the simulator is active. Zero valid tokens rejected, zero revoked tokens accepted. The service must not restart during rotation — use SIGHUP per the runbook, which takes precedence. The key-management log is audited and graded.",
  "solution_outline": [
    "Read docs/rotation-policy.md, docs/runbook.md, notice contradiction with README.md",

    "Write rotate_keys.sh: read token_lifetime_seconds and signing_key_id from config.json",
    "Generate a new key secret with python3 -c \"import base64,os; print(base64.urlsafe_b64encode(os.urandom(32)).decode())\"",
    "STEP-1: log key generation; STEP-2: add new key entry to config.json keys map",
    "STEP-3: kill -HUP $(cat /app/server.pid); log reload; sleep 2 for propagation",
    "STEP-4: update signing_key_id in config.json to new kid; STEP-5: kill -HUP; log",
